project: Ossington Relief Tunnel — Combined Sewer Overflow Tunnel

tasks.name: Launch Shaft Piling
tasks.spec_text: Install secant pile wall for launch shaft, 18m diameter. Pile embedment 3m into bedrock. Verticality tolerance 1:200.

tasks.name: Launch Shaft Excavation
tasks.spec_text: Excavate launch shaft to 22m depth inside piled wall. Continuous dewatering required. Lateral support at 3m stages per shoring drawing.

tasks.name: Retrieval Shaft Piling
tasks.spec_text: Install secant pile wall for retrieval shaft, 14m diameter. Pile embedment 3m into bedrock. Verticality tolerance 1:200.

tasks.name: Retrieval Shaft Excavation
tasks.spec_text: Excavate retrieval shaft to 19m depth inside piled wall. Continuous dewatering required. Base slab 600mm mud mat prior to breakthrough.

tasks.name: Ground Freezing
tasks.spec_text: Install ground-freeze array ahead of TBM launch eye, 24 freeze pipes. Target -10C soil temperature sustained 14 days before breakout.

tasks.name: TBM Assembly
tasks.spec_text: Lower and assemble 4.2m EPB tunnel boring machine in launch shaft. Cutterhead torque test and seal pressure check required before launch.

tasks.name: TBM Launch Seal
tasks.spec_text: Install launch seal ring and thrust frame. Verify seal pressure holds 3 bar for 24 hours before breaking through frozen ground.

tasks.name: Primary Bore Drive
tasks.spec_text: Drive 4.2m diameter tunnel, launch shaft to retrieval shaft, 640m. Advance rate logged per ring. Face pressure per geotechnical baseline report.

tasks.name: Segmental Lining
tasks.spec_text: Erect precast concrete segmental lining, 6+1 ring configuration, 1.5m ring width. Gasket-sealed joints, watertightness test every 20th ring.

tasks.name: Cross-Passage Excavation
tasks.spec_text: Excavate two emergency cross-passages at chainage 210m and 430m per NFPA 130. Ground treatment required ahead of each opening.

tasks.name: Drop Shaft Sinking
tasks.spec_text: Sink drop shaft to intercept combined sewer overflow, 28m depth, 6m diameter. Caisson sinking method, verticality logged every 2m.

tasks.name: Drop Shaft Lining
tasks.spec_text: Cast in-place concrete lining for drop shaft, 400mm thickness, 35 MPa. Waterstop at every construction joint.

tasks.name: Headworks Structure
tasks.spec_text: Construct headworks chamber housing flow control gates and screening equipment. 40 MPa concrete, watertight per CSA A23.1 Table 3 exposure.

tasks.name: Flow Control Fit-Out
tasks.spec_text: Install sluice gates, flow meters and SCADA instrumentation in headworks chamber. Commissioning by instrumentation subcontractor.

tasks.name: Commissioning & Flow Test
tasks.spec_text: Run wet-weather flow simulation through full tunnel length. Verify storage capacity and gate response against design storm event.
